items.name: Alexander
items.text: The legal team helped us structure our telemedicine platform across several states without any disruption to operations. Their guidance on regulatory compliance was clear, practical, and saved us from costly licensing mistakes.

items.name: Arseniy
items.text: I contacted him regarding a land-related issue. The lawyer promptly provided a detailed consultation, sent sample applications, and even helped with the paperwork.

items.text: There was a situation involving a refusal of an insurance payout. Thanks to the platform, I found a lawyer who helped win the case and obtain compensation.

items.text: I liked that the service prices were clear and known in advance. There were no surprises, as often happens with in-person consultations.

items.text: There were serious issues with terminating the rental agreement, including a conflict with the landlord. I had almost lost hope that everything would be resolved, but after reaching out here, the CONSULTANT manager helped me find an experienced lawyer within 15 minutes, and we resolved all issues in practically a week!!! I highly recommend turning here for consultation and legal assistance regarding conflicts or rental problems.

items.name: Richard
items.text: The lawyer provided to me by the consultant was professional, patient, and explained the legal steps I needed to take very clearly. I highly recommend the CONSULTANT app.

items.name: Roman
items.text: I submitted a legal question late in the evening and received a response by the next morning. The lawyer was professional, patient, and explained all the steps I needed to take in great detail. Additionally, they provided sample documents and helpful advice that made it quick and easy to prepare the necessary paperwork. Thanks to this, the process of resolving my issue was as smooth and stress-free as possible. I highly recommend this app to anyone in need of prompt and high-quality legal assistance.
